evals.name: tanstack-full-app-bulletproof-react
evals.source: P1 in .agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/problems.md, added by PR #4607 (pinned at 9409e00)
evals.setup: Clone alan2207/bulletproof-react at 9506629ed003a561c6627735480cce4994244bb4 and work in apps/react-vite (react-query + axios + react-query-auth, MSW mocks, vitest, playwright). Add e2e/tests/stale-list.spec.ts from .agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/migration.patch (reactive/data-client@9409e004346ef5297010f7a88d027657c4e1eb17); it fails on the baseline. Install the skill under test with `npx skills add reactive/data-client --skill data-client-setup -y` from the branch being evaluated. Environment workarounds that are not under test (README and P10 there): `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`, `cp .env.example .env`, Playwright `launchOptions.executablePath` for the preinstalled Chromium. Give the agent no other hints. Run it on the mid model at medium effort.
evals.expected_output: A complete migration off TanStack Query whose hook mapping follows the skill's TanStack Query migration guide, with all of the app's checks green.
assertions: No file under apps/react-vite/src imports from `@tanstack/react-query`, `@tanstack/react-query-devtools` or `react-query-auth`, and neither package is in package.json.
`tsc --noEmit`, the vitest suite and the playwright suite (including `e2e/tests/stale-list.spec.ts`) pass.
The agent read the TanStack Query migration reference (`references/tanstack-query-migration.md`) before converting hooks.
Reads use `useSuspense` (or `useDLE`), not Data Client's `useQuery`, in the component that renders the data; the per-feature `useXxx()` wrappers around `useQuery` are deleted.
Router loaders and hover prefetching use `ctrl.fetchIfStale()`.
The infinite comments list uses one `Collection` with `getPage` for later pages, and creating a comment uses that Collection's `push` without invalidating anything.
Updating a discussion does not call `expireAll`, `invalidate` or `fetch` on any list endpoint.
Logout calls `ctrl.resetEntireStore()`; login stores the returned user with `ctrl.setResponse()` on the current-user endpoint.

evals.name: tanstack-update-and-create-invalidation
evals.expected_output: Mutations go through `ctrl.fetch()` with pending state from `useLoading()`; the update drops its refetch entirely, and the create expires the paginated list.
assertions: The update calls `ctrl.fetch(DiscussionResource.partialUpdate, { id }, data)` (or `update`) and does not refetch, expire or invalidate the detail or the list afterwards.
The create calls `ctrl.fetch(DiscussionResource.create, data)` (or equivalent POST) followed by `ctrl.expireAll(DiscussionResource.getList)`, and does not `push` into a page-numbered list.
Pending state comes from `useLoading()`; success (to close the drawer) is tracked after the awaited fetch, not from a TanStack field.
No `useMutation`, `useQueryClient` or query key arrays remain in the converted code.

evals.name: tanstack-infinite-query
evals.expected_output: An endpoint with an envelope schema whose `data` is a Collection keyed only by discussionId, `paginationField: 'page'`, `getPage` for more, and a create endpoint using the Collection's `push`.
assertions: The list endpoint's schema is an envelope like `{ data: <Collection of Comment>, meta: ... }` and it sets `paginationField: 'page'`.
The Collection's `argsKey` (or equivalent) excludes `page`, so all pages and the create endpoint share one list.
Loading more calls `ctrl.fetch(<endpoint>.getPage, { discussionId, page: meta.page + 1 })`; there is no `pages.flatMap`.
Creating a comment uses the Collection's `push` as the schema (or `getComments.push`), with no invalidation call.
The component reads data with `useSuspense`, has no `isLoading` branch, and tracks load-more pending state with `useLoading()`.

evals.name: tanstack-loader-prefetch-and-enabled
evals.expected_output: The router and loaders take a Controller from useController(); loaders and the hover prefetch use fetchIfStale; the conditional query uses useSuspense with null args.
assertions: The router gets the Controller from `useController()` and passes it to the loaders in place of the QueryClient.
The loader returns or awaits `ctrl.fetchIfStale(DiscussionResource.get, { id: ... })`.
The hover prefetch calls `ctrl.fetchIfStale(DiscussionResource.get, { id })`.
The teams read uses `useSuspense` (or `useDLE`) with `null` in place of args when `chooseTeam` is false; it does not use Data Client's `useQuery`, and it does not keep `enabled`.

evals.name: tanstack-react-query-auth
evals.expected_output: Endpoints for me/login/register/logout; useUser reads with useSuspense; login and register store the user with setResponse on the me endpoint; logout resets the store; AuthLoader is removed in favor of Suspense.
assertions: `useUser` reads the current user with `useSuspense` on the `/auth/me` endpoint; it has no loading or `enabled` handling of its own.
Login and register call `ctrl.fetch` on their endpoints and then write the returned user with `ctrl.setResponse(<me endpoint>, ...)` (or `ctrl.set`) instead of refetching or invalidating.
Logout calls `ctrl.resetEntireStore()` after the logout request.
`AuthLoader` is removed; loading is left to a Suspense boundary that sits inside `DataProvider`.
No `react-query-auth` or `@tanstack/react-query` import remains in the converted files.

evals.name: suspense-inside-provider
evals.source: Migration of alan2207/bulletproof-react@9506629 (apps/react-vite), problem record in https://github.com/reactive/data-client/pull/4607 (.agents/projects/migrations/bulletproof-react/problems.md) P3
evals.prompt: Set up @data-client/react in this Vite app. Its src/main.tsx renders `<React.Suspense fallback={<Spinner />}><ErrorBoundary FallbackComponent={MainErrorFallback}><QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}><App /></QueryClientProvider></ErrorBoundary></React.Suspense>`. Replace React Query's provider with Data Client's; components will call useSuspense().
evals.expected_output: DataProvider moves above the app's Suspense instead of taking QueryClientProvider's place (at the root, or inside the ErrorBoundary, which is fine); the Suspense ends up between DataProvider and App. DataProvider's own backup Suspense would otherwise catch every suspend and show 'Uncaught Suspense'. Library check: the 'should not let a Suspense above DataProvider catch its children' test in packages/react/src/components/__tests__/provider.tsx.
assertions: `DataProvider` is above every Suspense boundary in the result, not left where `QueryClientProvider` was. An `ErrorBoundary` wrapping it is fine.
A `<Suspense>` or `<AsyncBoundary>` sits between `DataProvider` and `<App />`.
Says why: `DataProvider` has its own backup Suspense, so a boundary above it never catches.

evals.name: redux-full-app
evals.source: G1 in the Voyager migration (aeharding/voyager@6a15757): no Redux guidance. Held-out fixture, not Voyager.
evals.prompt: Migrate this app's server state from Redux to Reactive Data Client.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/redux-tunes (Redux Toolkit slices with createEntityAdapter, a likes override slice, a search thunk that upserts into the tracks slice, a websocket push, a thunk that fetches then changes client state, sign-out reset). Install the skills under test into .claude/skills. No network: tell the agent to skip installs and checks. Run it on the mid model at medium effort.
evals.expected_output: Server data moves to Entities and SDK-wrapping Endpoints with schemas; Redux keeps auth and queue.
assertions: `tracksSlice`, `likesSlice` and `searchSlice` are deleted; Redux keeps only client state (`auth`, `queue`), and `DataProvider` is outside the Redux `Provider`.
Search, album and track calls are Endpoints whose `schema` includes `Track` (and `Album`), each with a `name`; nothing copies their results into a store by hand.
No placeholder endpoint is filled with `ctrl.setResponse()`, and no module variable holds a Controller.
`likedById` overrides become Entity fields set by the like endpoint's `getOptimisticResponse()`.
The websocket push writes with `ctrl.set()` from a Manager (listening in `init()`, stopping in `cleanup()`).
Queuing a track gets the Controller from the thunk extra argument, a thunk argument, or a hook with `useController()`, and loads it with `ctrl.fetchIfStale()` or `ctrl.fetch()`.
Sign-out calls `ctrl.resetEntireStore()`.
Components read with `useSuspense()` (or `useQuery()` for Entities already loaded); none dispatches a fetch in `useEffect()`.

evals.name: redux-partial-thunk-and-push
evals.source: G1 in the Voyager migration: data arriving from non-endpoint code, reaching the Controller outside React.
evals.expected_output: History becomes an Endpoint with a Track schema read by useSuspense; the service worker listener becomes a Manager calling ctrl.set().
assertions: `getHistory` is an Endpoint (with a `name`) whose `schema` contains `[Track]`, read with `useSuspense()`; the history slice and `tracksReceived` are deleted.
No endpoint exists only to be filled with `ctrl.setResponse()`.

The service-worker listener moves into a Manager that keeps the Controller from `middleware`, adds the listener in `init()`, removes it in `cleanup()`, and writes with `controller.set(Track, ...)`; `managers` is a function passed to `DataProvider`.
No module variable holds a Controller, and `push.ts` no longer imports the Redux store.
